text: Given the decision made by the farm to upgrade their irrigation system, the most strategic choice would be to invest in the "kit the crew can lay before the dry month." This option prioritizes immediate availability and ease of installation over long-term warranties or high upfront costs. It aligns with the principle that flexibility and efficiency should take precedence over potentially higher expenditures. By selecting this solution, the farm ensures they can quickly implement improved water usage practices, reducing stress on the ecosystem and improving overall productivity during critical periods when natural rainfall may be scarce. This approach leverages the expertise and tools currently available to meet the pressing need for reliable irrigation without compromising future maintenance obligations.
